subtitle: 把检索工具放进独立服务，按协议发现和调用

question.zh-CN: 运行器连上手册检索服务，列出工具，检索两次，再查看服务进程拿到了哪些环境变量。
question.en: The runner connects to the handbook search server, lists its tools, searches twice and checks which environment variables reached the server process.

question.zh-CN: 同样的发现与调用，换成新协议版本：连接时先发 server/discover，不再有 initialize 握手。
question.en: The same discovery and calls on the newer protocol version: the connection starts with server/discover instead of the initialize handshake.

exercises.title: 错误路径：工具错误与协议错误

question.zh-CN: 运行器依次发出参数不符、未知工具、业务错误的调用，再让一个故障注入的服务在调用中途退出。
question.en: The runner sends a call with bad arguments, one to an unknown tool and one that breaks a business rule, then lets a fault-injected server exit in the middle of a call.
